description: Update a custom field definition: rename the label, flip required, replace a select's options, or change a currency field's currencyCode. The TYPE is immutable, because changing it would invalidate every stored value; a different type means a new field (archiving the old one happens in the app). Changing currencyCode relabels existing values without converting them: the numbers stay as entered. Field ids come from get_item_requirements. Requires the manager role. Idempotent.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 code (currency fields only), e.g. EUR or CHF. The organization's default currency applies only when a field is created. Relabels existing values, never converts them.

name: update_field_def

currencyCode.description: ISO code of a currency field when it is not CHF (absent = CHF)

label.description: Field label as the org named it

type.description: Field type: text | number | date | select | multiselect | …

title: Update field definition
